name: mysql-8.0-derived-union
query:
SELECT * FROM customers c
JOIN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' UNION SELECT id FROM customers WHERE country = 'JP') u
  ON u.customer_id = c.id

outputs.tree:
-> Nested loop inner join  (cost=44.2e+6 rows=442e+6)
    -> Table scan on c  (cost=2092 rows=19947)
    -> Single-row covering index lookup on u using <auto_distinct_key> (customer_id=c.id)  (cost=22396..22396 rows=1)
        -> Union materialize with deduplication  (cost=22395..22395 rows=22138)
            -> Filter: (orders.`status` = 'cancelled')  (cost=19890 rows=19281)
                -> Table scan on orders  (cost=19890 rows=192810)
            -> Covering index lookup on customers using customers_country_idx (country='JP')  (cost=292 rows=2857)
